{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured dark denim jacket, boxy cut, hip length, deep charcoal gray, durable twill.
High-waisted straight-leg jeans in mid-rise, full-length, classic indigo, heavy weight cotton stretch.
A fitted crew-neck knit top, boat neck, cropped at the waist, soft oat beige, fine-gauge merino wool.
Leather Chelsea boots with a low block heel, ankle length, polished black, smooth calf leather.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an autumn evening date at a restaurant while adhering to her preference for "everyday" style. The structured denim jacket elevates the casual jeans and knit top into a refined yet comfortable look suitable for a dinner setting. The dark charcoal and indigo tones create a sophisticated palette that feels appropriate for the evening hour without crossing into formal territory. Completing the ensemble with sleek black leather boots adds a touch of polish and practicality for any outdoor arrival before settling into the restaurant."}
